description:
Welcome home to this beautiful and spacious 3-bedroom, 2-full-bathroom rental in the highly desirable Kamm's Corner neighborhood! With an abundance of living space, thoughtful updates, and a fantastic location, this home offers the perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and character.

The spacious upstairs loft is a standout feature, offering vaulted ceilings, abundant natural light, and its own full bathroommaking it an ideal primary suite, home office, guest space, or private retreat.

On the main floor, you'll find two additional bedrooms and a full bathroom, along with an inviting kitchen and dining area. The kitchen features a large island, generous cabinet space, and plenty of room for cooking, entertaining, and gathering.

The partially finished basement adds even more flexibility, featuring fresh paint and new carpet. It can easily serve as an additional living room, recreation area, home gym, office, or hobby space. The unfinished portion provides convenient in-home washer and dryer access as well as additional storage.

Outside, is a large two-car garage, complete with an upstairs loft offering excellent additional storage. Enjoy your morning coffee or unwind in the evening on the large, inviting front porch. The property also includes a small yard that is fenced on three sides, providing a nice outdoor space for relaxing or entertaining.

Location is one of this home's biggest advantages. Conveniently situated near I-71 and I-90, commuting to downtown Cleveland and other parts of the city is quick and easy. The home is also less than a mile from Cleveland Clinic Fairview Hospital, making it especially convenient for healthcare professionals. Best of all, you're just minutes from the heart of Kamm's Corner, a charming and walkable neighborhood with a variety of restaurants, shops, and a short walk to the Metro Parks.
